title: docs/adr: a sunset rule for @deprecated tombstones — 574 tags (504 in packages/types, 640 'never' members) with no rule for when a tombstone leaves the authoring face
body:
Ruled: 6392108885 · letter A · 2026-10-25T01:47Z

Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

`@deprecated` 574 处，504 在 `packages/types`，绝大多数是 `key?: never` 墓碑（640 行）——这是契约按设计在工作（#0.1：退役键留处方），不是死代码。缺的是一条日落规则：「spec 退役后 N 个 major，墓碑离开授权面」。没有它，授权面只增不减，每个墓碑都是永久义务（北极星「声明了但不兑现的键按发布批量退役」）。建议写成一篇 ADR（受管面 `docs/adr/**`），不做横扫。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- `@deprecated` tags outside tests, dist and changelogs: 574; by package: types 504 (`objectql.ts` 93, `data-display.ts` 69, `form.ts` 55), react 18, core 17, plugin-timeline 8, plugin-calendar 5, components 4.
- `?: never` members in `packages/types/src`: 640 lines; sample shape: `/** @deprecated RETIRED (objectui#11533) … */ field?: never;` on `ConditionalFormattingRule` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`.
- Age of the tombstones is 未实测 here (the review clone was shallow to 2026-09-05; `git log -S` on a full clone settles it).
- The zod side keeps 16 retired keys as `z.never` tombstones with remedies across the mirrored pairs — the right shape under #0.1; the missing half is the exit.
- Business reason: an AI author reading the published `.d.ts` sees hundreds of refused keys beside the live ones; the longer the list, the more the face teaches what not to write instead of what to write.
- Dedup (`@deprecated|tombstone … sunset|sunset rule`): 10 hits, 0 open, all individual retirements (e.g. objectui#12293, objectstack-ai/objectui#12257, objectstack-ai/objectui#12065, objectstack-ai/objectui#11993); no card proposes the rule.

## Task

- [ ] An ADR (docs/adr, governed) stating: a tombstone leaves the authoring face one major after the spec retirement it names (or after the spec's own retirement window closes, whichever the maintainer picks), and the changeset that drops it is `minor` with a breaking note per AGENTS 版本号策略.
- [ ] A one-line pointer from AGENTS.md #0.1 to the ADR (governed; can ride the AGENTS merge card objectui#13455).
- [ ] No sweep in this card; the first batch to apply the rule is its own card once the ADR lands.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat drafts the ADR; maintainer approves (governed surface). Effort S.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential).
